geogebra-open-file: Link text for the fallback shown when no player URL is configured.
geogebra-empty: Shown when the <geogebra> tag has no commands.
geogebra-too-long:
Shown when the <geogebra> tag's commands exceed the configured limit. Parameters:
* $1 — the byte limit
geogebra-no-player: Shown when the <geogebra> tag is used but no player URL is configured.
geogebra-commands-disabled: Shown when the <geogebra> tag is used but raw commands are disabled in configuration.
geogebra-short-desc:
Short description of a GeoGebra file. Parameters:
* $1 — the file name
geogebra-long-desc: Long description of a GeoGebra file.
